headline: Liberia Prepares Exporters for Extended US Market Access Under AGOA
summary: Liberian businesses are preparing quality control and export documentation upgrades after the U.S. extended duty-free access under the African Growth and Opportunity Act through 2028.
why: AGOA provides eligible Sub-Saharan African countries duty-free access to U.S. consumer markets, spurring agricultural, textile, and manufacturing export development.
